# Snowflake Partner Network

Join the platform where the world's most data-driven companies build. The Snowflake Partner Network (SPN) provides resources and opportunities to grow your business and deliver more value for your customers.

Already a partner? [Log in](https://spn.snowflake.com/s/login/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fs%2F)

Overview

## Find your place. Fuel long-term growth.

Whether you build, consult, resell or integrate, the Snowflake Partner Network connects you with the customers, programs and co-sell support to grow at every stage.

Benefits

## Accelerate your Snowflake business

Join the Snowflake Partner Network (SPN) to capitalize on a platform that is easy to adopt and scale, so you can unlock new revenue and grow with your customers.

Mutual Benefits

## Your customers win when you partner with Snowflake

Your customers get access to a fully managed AI ready platform with faster time to value. You get what you need to grow alongside them.

| | What you get | What your customers get |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue acceleration | Global market access | Streamlined transactions |
| Sales alignment | Elevated positioning | Faster time to value |
| Market differentiation | Growth levers | Modernization |
| Enablement | Expert experience | Knowledge transfer |

![The Snowflake AI Data Cloud is a united platform and connected ecosystem](https://snowflake.com/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--d7a170a6-f150-4f34-bdf4-eda0b171d35d/ai-data-cloud-feb26.png?quality=85&preferwebp=true&sfver=f0370708)

A trusted platform

## Get ahead of the AI opportunity

- Your customers are already betting on AI and data. Partner with Snowflake and get the tools, brand and ecosystem to be the one who helps them win.
- Join more than 14,000 partners building what enterprise customers need next. Get early access to Snowflake's product roadmap and ecosystem to lead as demand for AI-powered data solutions accelerates.
- Leading brands worldwide trust Snowflake with their AI and data estates. Partnering with Snowflake lets you build on the brand your customers already run on.

![Accenture logo](https://snowflake.com/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--9cacaac4-ce3b-4af7-9076-0859c1b40feb/accenture.svg1.png?quality=85&preferwebp=true&sfver=22e2b6ef)

PARTNER TESTIMONIAL

"Snowflake, historically, has found to be the most collaborative firm, whether it comes to field sales, solution engineering, or partnering."

Sreekumar Vadakkepat
 Global Managing Director, Accenture

SPN Offerings

## Programs for every stage of your partner journey

From building awareness to scaling impact and driving consumption, we have initiatives to support you.

#### Awareness

Be where Snowflake customers are already looking.

**Marketplace listings**

List your data, app or solution on the [Snowflake Marketplace](https://snowflake.com/en/product/features/marketplace/) in minutes. Reach 14,000+ Snowflake customers for greater reach.

**Event partnerships**

[Connect](https://www.snowflake.com/en/why-snowflake/partners/event-partnership-opportunities/) with fellow data and AI leaders at [Snowflake Summit](https://www.snowflake.com/en/summit/) and exclusive partner gatherings.

**Directory listing**

[Browse](https://www.snowflake.com/en/why-snowflake/partners/all-partners/) certified system integrators, resellers and product partners globally to maximize your Snowflake deployment.

**Press releases and customer stories**

Get Snowflake press and brand content support to amplify your partnership milestones and customer wins.

#### Pipeline acceleration

Sell smarter and build expertise with AI-powered sales tools, specialized training and deal protection.

**AI ready sales accelerators**

Use plain language with [Cortex Code](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/cortex-code/) and [Snowflake Intelligence](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/snowflake-intelligence/) to pitch more effectively and close deals faster.

**Specialized training**

Level up your Snowflake expertise in hands-on labs, certifications and persona-based learning tracks on [SPN Learn](https://learn.snowflake.com/en/pages/spn-track/) and [Snowflake University](https://learn.snowflake.com/en/).

**Joint pipeline**

Register deals to secure exclusive opportunity credit and grow co-sell momentum with Snowflake's sales team.

#### Growth and consumption

Win customers and expand your reach through SPN program support and benefits.

**Go-to-market support**

Sell Snowflake as part of your solutions with aligned sales teams and joint go-to-market investments behind you.

**Revenue incentives**

Earn referral rebates on new deals, service credits on expansion opportunities and co-marketing dollars to power your strategy.

**Industry competency badges**

Stand out with Snowflake-recognized badges that signal deep expertise to customers.

## Take the next step with the Snowflake Partner Network

Snowflake Partner Network

## Frequently Asked Questions

The most common questions about Snowflake's Partner Network, answered here.

Start at [spn.snowflake.com](http://spn.snowflake.com), where you can explore partner types and find the path that fits your business. Once you're in, you get access to the programs with tiered build, market and sell resources that match your partner type.

Benefits vary by partner type and tier, but most partners get access to co-sell support, Marketplace listing options, sandbox credits, technical training and co-marketing programs. As you reach higher tiers, the level of investment and program support from Snowflake increases.

The Snowflake Marketplace provides a direct channel for providers to reach a global audience of Snowflake customers. Most importantly, partner offerings can be eligible for Marketplace Capacity Drawdown (MCD), allowing customers to purchase solutions using their existing Snowflake committed spend, drastically simplifying the procurement process.

Requirements vary by partner type. Partners can expect to see tiering requirements based on variables such as: adoption metrics, revenue, certification and customer success thresholds. Higher tiers unlock greater benefits and investment.

Get started as a Registered partner at no cost. As your business scales, our Select, Premier and Elite tiers offer an expanded suite of program benefits. An annual investment is associated with these higher tiers, payable upon achievement to unlock your exclusive rewards and resources.
